:::{.r-stack}
::::{}
```{r}
#| label: dp_cft_1
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 5

p.dp.cft <- draws.post |>
  filter(measure=='Probability of Imagining the Counterfactual') |>
  ggplot(aes(x=factor(COND), y=.value, fill=variable)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name='', values=DP_PALETTE, drop=FALSE,
    breaks=c('Double\nPreventer', 'Possible\nPreventer', 'Productive\nFactor')
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    expand=expansion(add=c(0, 0), mult=c(-1, 1)), drop=FALSE,
    breaks=c('Control', 'Manipulation')
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous('Probability of Imagining the Counterfactual', expand=expansion(),
    limits=c(0, 1), breaks=seq(0, 1, by=.25), labels=c('0', '.25', '.5', '.75', '1')) +
  theme_classic(18) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x=element_blank(),
    legend.position='none'
  )

p.dp.cft
```
::::

```{r}
#| label: dp_cft_2
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 5

p.dp.cft +
  stat_slab(
    density=density_bounded(bounds=c(0, 1), bandwidth=.005), alpha=.9,
    data = ~ filter(., variable=='Productive\nFactor', COND=='Control')
  ) +
  stat_pointinterval(
    .width=.95,
    data = ~ filter(., variable=='Productive\nFactor', COND=='Control')
  )
```
